newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel Chemical up on share allocation news.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel Chemical up on share allocation news.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Steel Chemical Co Ltd were higher on Tuesday afternoon as investors welcomed the news that the company was planning a third-party share allocation, brokers said.
At 0345 GMT, the shares were 45 yen higher at 480 yen, the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Nippon Steel Corp said last Friday that its subsidiary's restructuring plans included a third-party share allotment. It said it would buy 34.7 billion yen worth of the shares that Nippon Steel Chemical was planning to issue.
Brokers said that apart from the share allotment news, the passing of the expiry date for margin transactions was also making it easy for investors to buy the shares.

Shares of Nippon Steel Semiconductor Corp, another Nippon Steel group firm, also rose, inspired by bullish U.S. semiconductor book-to-bill data. The shares stood at 1.21 million yen after closing at 1.16 million on Monday.
